summary: Implemented a request-local verified snapshot handoff in Client/SignalR/Client.fs: after a successful Ready activation, loadWithConfirmedWrite now supplies the same confirmed snapshot to Working-turn guidance instead of triggering a second loadWithSnapshot/fetch. The snapshot remains request-scoped; ordinary pre-activation observations are not reused after cache invalidation, preserving refresh behavior. AgentInbox keeps its existing snapshot semantics under the clearer RequestSnapshot name. Extended OrdinaryDispatchGitTests with cold-process/fetch budgets and a zero-Git warm Working negative control. Release baseline on the same fixture was 82 Git process starts, 4 remote fetches, 501ms (existing file) / 417ms (missing file); warm Working was 0/0/1ms and 0/0/0ms.
